g.text: READING NOTES — the complete read/write matrix for every store is in docs/DFD-REVIEW.md §5.
1. 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 and 7.0 each append an audit row to T5 (one arrow per writer). 8.0 reads, filters and exports the trail.
2. Session checks are not repeated on every process: all routes re-validate the caller against T7 through 1.0 (see docs/DFD.md §3).
3. 4.0 reads T6 (weights & thresholds) on every run; 6.0 reads T6 for display thresholds. Only 8.0 writes settings, so the read is drawn once via 6.0 and the T6↔8.0 pair.

4. E1 is the front-desk “User” account (any authenticated staff session). E2 is the Team Leader acting on records and patrols; E3 is the only administrator; E4 (Kagawad) is read-only. The overlap between E1 and E2–E4 is discussed in docs/DFD-REVIEW.md §6.
